title: Stream-R1: Real-Time Reward-Guided Video Distillation
summary: Stream-R1 is an accelerated video generation model distilled from Wan2.1 that achieves real-time performance of 23.1 FPS. It utilizes Reward-Guided Distribution-Matching Distillation (DMD) to surpass its teacher model in both visual quality and text alignment.
research_notes: Achieves a 30x speedup over the original Wan2.1 while maintaining high VBench scores; developed by FrameX-AI in collaboration with USTC.

evolution.summary: Following the release of Stream-R1, FrameX-AI introduced Stream-T1, a specialized framework focusing on Test-Time Scaling (TTS) to improve temporal consistency and complex motion handling without retraining the base weights.
